results.title: Act 3
results.overview: The latest in Christine Molloy and Joe Lawlor’s series of cinematic essays is a rich and thought- provoking journey through aging, legacy and the intersection between artistic and personal relationships. Molloy and Lawlor engage in a witty and moving conversation that explores family history and their latest project, a film about groundbreaking artists Claude Cahun and Marcel Moore. As they analyse this decades-long relationship, they identify parallels between these two artists and their own lives. Act 3 celebrates the power of connection, of artistic exploration and the importance of memory to shape our present and future.

results.title: Danur: The Last Chapter
results.overview: After years of separation from her ghost friends, Risa goes on with her life, closing the door to any communication with any ghosts. However, things change when her sister, Riri, is proposed. In an old theater and begins acting strangely in the time leading to her wedding. Not only does Riri change, but Risa also begins experiencing a series of strange events, as if she’s experiencing a painful death repeatedly. Risa suspects that this was happening because her ghost friends, Peter and his friends, were trying to convey something.

results.title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
results.original_title: Lobang Buaya, 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah
results.overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

results.title: Jane Elliott Against the World
results.overview: A rural Iowa schoolteacher becomes a national voice against racism after leading a controversial 1968 lesson in discrimination with her all-white third-grade class. Now nearly 90, she refuses to hold back amid today’s fights about race, history, and power after a lifetime of speaking out.

results.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
results.original_title: คดีชมพู่:​ เด็กหายที่ถูกลืม
results.overview: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

results.title: The Raid
results.overview: When an anti-narcotics raid goes disastrously wrong, officer Chen Fei is left with the devastating loss of her undercover partner. Lin Xiao’s final sacrifice delivers crucial evidence, propelling Chen Fei into a high-stakes mission to dismantle an international drug trafficking network once and for all.

results.title: Dry Leaf
results.overview: Lisa, a photographer, has gone missing. The last known detail is that she had been photographing rural football stadiums in villages across Georgia. Her father, Irakli, sets out to search for her, traveling from place to place. Levani, Lisa's best friend – and an invisible person – also sets off to help.

results.title: Turncoat
results.overview: A psychotic mastermind holds a group of interconnected strangers captive in a manipulative game with deadly consequences. Young and old, sinners and saints — everyone's guilty of something, but no one wants to pay the price.

results.title: Nothing Between Us
results.overview: Living in Mexico City, Guillermo and Mechi, in Buenos Aires, are separated by over 4,000 miles and their marriages, both having structured family lives. Working for the same multinational food manufacturer they meet by chance at a corporate offsite. The attraction between them proves immediate and irresistible. The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

results.title: Parimala and Co
results.overview: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

results.title: Akal Imitasi
results.overview: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

results.title: Center Stage for Murder
results.overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

results.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
results.overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

results.title: Checkout: The Movie
results.overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

results.title: Ibadah & Cinta
results.overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

results.title: Korean Haunted Hospital
results.overview: A group of Indonesian friends travel to South Korea to live-stream a courage test inside an abandoned hospital with a dark history of cult activity, hoping to become the first to explore its supposedly haunted halls.

results.title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
results.original_title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
results.overview: Raised in the shadow of an emotionally distant father, a young woman must step up during a family crisis and navigate the burdens of adulthood without the guidance she always craved.

results.title: Son of Revenge – The Story of Kalevala
results.overview: Karelia in the 11th century. A brutal feud between Kalervo and Untamo leads to the massacre of an entire village. The sole survivor is Kalervo's son, Kullervo, whom Untamo decides to raise as his own. As he grows, Kullervo's immense strength and rebellious nature make him feared by those around him. When he learns the truth about his past, his path becomes clear: revenge. His journey takes him across a harsh and treacherous land and into the hands of slave traders, only to uncover a devastating secret that will change his fate forever.
